svg.title: Grass
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Painted green stem and eight tapering blades observed in essayfigure37; white paper preserved. Thin pencil construction and brush texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for green; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=40; record guggenheim1996-essay-40-fig-37; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
